title: 失败时保留事实与恢复线索

summary: Root resolution walks up to the nearest .git or .aios/project.yaml. When the OS temp dir is not writable, Python falls back to the process cwd, so pytest fixtures landed inside this repository and resolved to the real project: memory tests wrote fixture records into the tracked docs/memory/memory.jsonl. Fixed by pinning basetemp to .aios/pytest, setting GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES per test, and giving isolated cases an explicit project boundary.
title: pytest basetemp inside a governed repo leaks fixtures into real project facts

summary: Two files carry checksums that bulk text edits silently break: tests/fixtures/runtime_12b723b.sql (its text is hashed to reproduce a legacy migration checksum) and src/aios/infrastructure/migrations/0001_initial.sql (its digest is the checksum stored in schema_migrations). Changing one comment in either made an existing database report MIGRATION_UNKNOWN_SCHEMA or MIGRATION_REQUIRED. Both are now byte-frozen and excluded from renames.
title: Checksum-bearing artifacts must be excluded from bulk renames

summary: On DSH only tools/pre-execute can deny, cancel, or ask before dispatch; fs/write-intent and fs/edit-intent are single-slot write-intent decisions that cannot refuse anything. The plugin therefore registers exactly one enforcement listener and forwards every payload to aios authorize-dsh, so the CLI, MCP server, and plugin cannot drift into separate rule sets.
title: One deny point, registered once, backed by one kernel
